messages.subject: Lyra - disclosure letter and data room
messages.plaintextBody:
Hi Sofia,

I've drafted the Series C disclosure letter. A few items I want to confirm we should disclose against the warranties:

- The Orbital Data geospatial licence expiring 31 October (IP warranty)
- The customer non-renewal in February (~4% of ARR)
- The VP Commercial package consultation
- The outstanding R&D tax-credit review with HMRC

Can you confirm the data-room references for each so I can cross-reference? I'll send you the draft disclosure letter shortly.

Elena

--
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
www.whitfieldcarter.com
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
